title: 非农亮眼：美元却跌，CPI能否扭转信心动摇？
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I think it's really quite clear that when we saw the reactions of the dollar on Friday to that stronger than expected payrolls, well it wasn't very good and that I think suggests
segments.zh: 我认为很明显，上周五美元对强于预期的就业数据的反应并不理想，这表明

segments.en: that the confidence behind the dollar really has been weakened and that I would say has probably got something to do with all that discussion about dollar debatement that we had
segments.zh: 市场对美元的信心确实有所减弱，这可能与几周前美国财政部访谈后关于美元贬值的讨论有关。

segments.en: after the US Treasury interview just a few weeks ago. So in terms of looking ahead to the CPI data, well I think if this number is on the stronger side of expectations, we will
segments.zh: 展望CPI数据，如果数据强于预期，美元仍将获得提振，因为市场将强化对美联储近期加息的预期。

segments.en: still get a bit of a boost for the dollar because the market will after all strengthen those expectations for an interest rate hike pretty close in the near term for the Fed. So there is still
segments.zh: 因此，CPI数据仍将对美元产生重要影响，但美元看起来比春季和夏季时更加不稳定。

segments.en: obviously that the CPI data still has going to have a strong leaning on the dollar but I think the dollar is looking more wobbly than certainly it was in the spring and into the summer and
segments.zh: 这不仅仅与美国基本面有关，还存在一些关于美元兑日元以及日元可能大幅升值的担忧。

segments.en: that of course is not just to do with US fundamentals. I think there's some overhang here about the market market thinking about dollar yen and the possibility that the yen could strengthen
segments.zh: 这当然不仅与美国基本面有关。我认为这里存在一些悬而未决的问题，市场在考虑美元兑日元以及日元可能走强的可能性。

segments.en: potentially quite a lot against the US dollar.
segments.zh: 可能对美元造成相当大的压力。
